pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of additional position building unless existing position is locked at minimum +1.5x ATR trailing profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Block all new entry triggers between 21:00 and 00:00 UTC and enforce a minimum 15-second debouncing window to prevent concurrent multi-ticket orders.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate dynamic trailing stop to lock +$3.00 immediately once floating profit reaches +$5.00, allowing uncapped expansion to $15-$30 targets.
